msg: warning: Variable newuri is used uninitialized!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: dbafef17dd1.c (Apache rewrite). Alarm fires at line 11, columns 37-45 ('sizeof(newuri)' inside strncpy call), when def(HAS_APACHE_REGEX_LIB). The tool claims 'newuri' used in sizeof(newuri) is 'used uninitialized,' but sizeof evaluates the TYPE of its operand at compile time — it does not dereference or read the runtime value of newuri. This is the same pattern as FAMILY_66 (sizeof(*ch)). False positive from the tool misidentifying a compile-time sizeof operation as a runtime read.
